Out of 269 administrative blocks, 38
blocks are categorised as ‘Semi-critical’ and
the rest are ‘Safe’ (Table 9.2). Categorisation
of blocks does not take into account the
quality of groundwater. Hence there may be
several ‘safe’ blocks where the groundwater
contains high concentration of arsenic,
fluoride etc. and hence may not be safe for
drinking.
